name: Aura: Protective Wards
descr:
Granted by [Protective Wards](/spell/protective-wards-player-core)

You and any allies in the area gain a +1 status bonus to AC. Each time you Sustain the spell, the emanation's radius increases by 5 feet, to a maximum of 30 feet.

name: Aura: Protector's Sphere
descr:
Granted by [Protector'S Sphere](/spell/protector-s-sphere-player-core)

You gain resistance to all damage. Your allies also gain this resistance while in the aura.

name: Aura: Spiral of Horrors
descr:
Granted by [Spiral Of Horrors](/spell/spiral-of-horrors-player-core)

Foes in the area are frightened 1 and unable to reduce the condition.

name: Blinded
descr: You can't see. All normal terrain is difficult terrain to you. You can't detect anything using vision. You automatically critically fail Perception checks that require you to be able to see, and if vision is your only precise sense, you take a –4 status penalty to Perception checks. You are immune to visual effects. Blinded overrides Dazzled.

name: Broken
descr:
Broken is a condition that affects only objects. An object is broken when damage has reduced its Hit Points to equal or less than its Broken Threshold. A broken object can't be used for its normal function, nor does it grant bonuses—with the exception of armor. Broken armor still grants its item bonus to AC, but it also imparts a status penalty to AC depending on its category: –1 for broken light armor, –2 for broken medium armor, or –3 for broken heavy armor.

A broken item still imposes penalties and limitations normally incurred by carrying, holding, or wearing it. For example, broken armor would still impose its Dexterity modifier cap, check penalty, and so forth. If an effect makes an item broken automatically and the item has more HP than its Broken Threshold, that effect also reduces the item's current HP to the Broken Threshold.

name: Clumsy
descr: Your movements become clumsy and inexact. Clumsy always includes a value. You take a status penalty equal to the condition value to Dexterity-based rolls and DCs, including AC, Reflex saves, ranged attack rolls, and skill checks using Acrobatics, Stealth, and Thievery.

name: Concealed
descr: You are difficult for one or more creatures to see due to thick fog or some other obscuring feature. You can be concealed to some creatures but not others. While concealed, you can still be Observed, but you're tougher to target. A creature that you're concealed from must succeed at a Flat DC 5 when targeting you with an attack, spell, or other effect. If the check fails, you aren't affected. Area effects aren't subject to this flat check.

name: Confused
descr:
You don't have your wits about you, and you attack wildly. You are Off Guard, you don't treat anyone as your ally (though they might still treat you as theirs), and you can't Delay, Ready, or use reactions.

You use all your actions to Strike or cast offensive cantrips, though the GM can have you use other actions to facilitate attack, such as draw a weapon, move so target is in reach, and so forth. Your targets are determined randomly by the GM. If you have no other viable targets, you target yourself, automatically hitting but not scoring a critical hit. If it's impossible for you to attack or cast spells, you babble incoherently, wasting your actions.

Each time you take damage from an attack or spell, you can attempt a Flat DC 11 to recover from your confusion and end the condition.

name: Controlled
descr: You have been commanded, magically dominated, or otherwise had your will subverted. The controller dictates how you act and can make you use any of your actions, including attacks, reactions, or even Delay. The controller usually doesn't have to spend their own actions when controlling you.

name: Dazzled
descr: Your eyes are overstimulated or your vision is swimming. If vision is your only precise sense, all creatures and objects are Concealed from you.

name: Deafened
descr: You can't hear. You automatically critically fail Perception checks that require you to be able to hear. You take a –2 status penalty to Perception checks for initiative and checks that involve sound but also rely on other senses. If you perform an action that has the auditory trait, you must succeed at a Flat DC 5 or the action is lost; attempt the check after spending the action but before any effects are applied. You are immune to auditory effects while deafened.

name: Doomed
descr:
Your soul has been gripped by a powerful force that calls you closer to death. Doomed always includes a value. The Dying value at which you die is reduced by your doomed value. If your maximum dying value is reduced to 0, you instantly die. When you die, you're no longer doomed.

Your doomed value decreases by 1 each time you get a full night's rest.

name: Drained
descr:
Your health and vitality have been depleted as you've lost blood, life force, or some other essence. Drained always includes a value. You take a status penalty equal to your drained value on Constitution-based rolls and DCs, such as Fortitude saves. You also lose a number of Hit Points equal to your level (minimum 1) times the drained value, and your maximum Hit Points are reduced by the same amount. For example, if you become drained 3 and you're a 3rd-level character, you lose 9 Hit Points and reduce your maximum Hit Points by 9. Losing these Hit Points doesn't count as taking damage.

Each time you get a full night's rest, your drained value decreases by 1. This increases your maximum Hit Points, but you don't immediately recover the lost Hit Points.

name: Dying
descr:
You are bleeding out or otherwise at death's door. While you have this condition, you are Unconscious. Dying always includes a value, and if it ever reaches dying 4, you die. When you're dying, you must attempt a recovery check at the start of your turn each round to determine whether you get better or worse. Your dying condition increases by 1 if you take damage while dying, or by 2 if you take damage from an enemy's critical hit or a critical failure on your save.

If you lose the dying condition by succeeding at a recovery check and are still at 0 Hit Points, you remain unconscious, but you can wake up as described in that condition. You lose the dying condition automatically and wake up if you ever have 1 Hit Point or more. Any time you lose the dying condition, you gain the Wounded 1 condition, or increase your wounded condition value by 1 if you already have that condition.

name: Effect: Adverse Subsist Situation
descr:
Granted by [Subsist](/action/subsist-player-core)

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to checks to Subsist.

name: Effect: Aid
descr:
Granted by [Aid](/action/aid-player-core)

You gain a circumstance bonus to the aided check based on the result of your ally's Aid check.

name: Effect: Aquatic Combat
descr:
See [Aquatic Combat](/rule/aquatic-combat-rules-2438)

Use these rules for battles in water or underwater:

You're off-guard unless you have a swim Speed.You gain resistance 5 to acid and fire.You take a –2 circumstance penalty to your attack roll for bludgeoning or slashing attacks that pass through water.Ranged attacks made by an underwater creature or against an underwater target have their range increments halved.You can't cast fire spells or use actions with the [fire](/trait/fire) trait underwater. As normal for how traits work, any part of the effect that's unrelated to fire still works. For example, an attack with a *flaming battleaxe* could still deal its physical damage, just not its fire damage.

[Effect: Remaining Air](/condition/effect-remaining-air-player-core)

name: Effect: Assisting Shot
descr:
Granted by [Assisting Shot](/feat/assisting-shot-player-core)

You gain a circumstance bonus to your attack roll.

name: Effect: Attitude
descr:
See Attitudes

Use this effect to keep track of the attitude of relevant NPCs, increasing or decreasing the effect's badge value as needed.

name: Effect: Avert Gaze
descr:
Granted by [Avert Gaze](/action/avert-gaze-player-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against visual abilities that require you to look at a creature or object, such as a medusa's petrifying gaze.

name: Effect: Bespell Strikes
descr:
Granted by [Bespell Strikes](/feat/bespell-strikes-player-core)

The weapon or unarmed attack deals an extra 1d6 force damage and gains the [arcane](/trait/arcane) trait if it didn't have it already. If the spell dealt a different type of damage, the Strike deals this type of damage instead.

name: Effect: Caltrops
descr:
Granted by [Caltrops](/item/caltrops-player-core)

You take 1 persistent bleed damage. While taking this persistent bleed damage, you take a –5-foot penalty to your Speed.

name: Effect: Cast Down
descr:
Granted by [Cast Down](/feat/cast-down-player-core)

You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speed.

name: Effect: Castigating Weapon
descr:
Granted by [Castigating Weapon](/feat/castigating-weapon-player-core)

Your weapon or unarmed Strikes gain your holy or [unholy](/trait/unholy) trait and deal additional spirit damage.

name: Effect: Channeling Block
descr:
Granted by [Channeling Block](/feat/channeling-block-player-core)

Roll 1d8 for each rank of the [Heal](/spell/heal-player-core) or [Harm](/spell/harm-player-core) spell, and increase the shield's Hardness by the total for this block.

name: Effect: Coven Spell
descr:
Granted by [Coven Spell](/feat/coven-spell-player-core)

You gain a status bonus to your spell's damage equal to its rank.

name: Effect: Cover
descr: When you're behind an obstacle that could block weapons, guard you against explosions, and make you harder to detect, you're behind cover. Standard cover gives you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC, to Reflex saves against area effects, and to Stealth checks to Hide, Sneak, or otherwise avoid detection. You can increase this to greater cover using the Take Cover basic action, increasing the circumstance bonus to +4. If cover is especially light, typically when it's provided by a creature, you have lesser cover, which grants a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. A creature with standard cover or greater cover can attempt to use Stealth to Hide, but lesser cover isn't sufficient.

name: Effect: Current Spell
descr:
Granted by [Current Spell](/feat/current-spell-player-core) if you cast a spell with the [air](/trait/air) trait.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC or a +2 circumstance bonus against ranged attacks. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saves against effects with the selected trait.

This effect has the selected trait.

name: Effect: Cut from the Air
descr:
Granted by [Cut From The Air](/feat/cut-from-the-air-player-core).

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Effect: Defensive Recovery
descr:
Granted by [Defensive Recovery](/feat/defensive-recovery-player-core)

You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws.

name: Effect: Deity's Protection
descr:
Granted by [Deity'S Protection](/feat/deity-s-protection-player-core)

You gain resistance to all damage.

name: Effect: Disarm (Bonus)
descr:
Granted by [Disarm](/action/disarm-player-core) via Ephemeral Effect.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Disarm.

name: Effect: Disarm (Success)
descr:
Granted by [Disarm](/action/disarm-player-core)

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to attacks using the targeted item. Further attempts to Disarm you gain a +2 circumstance bonus.

name: Effect: Distracting Feint
descr:
Granted by [Distracting Feint](/feat/distracting-feint-player-core)

While you are off-guard by the origin's Feint, you also takes a -2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks and Reflex saves.

name: Effect: Divine Castigation
descr:
Imposed by [Divine Castigation](/feat/divine-castigation-player-core)

[Heal](/spell/heal-player-core) spells you cast damage fiends as though they were undead.

name: Effect: Divine Infusion
descr:
Granted by [Divine Infusion](/feat/divine-infusion-player-core)

You deal additional damage with your melee weapons and unarmed attacks. The damage type is void if you cast *harm* and vitality if you cast *heal*.

name: Effect: Divine Rebuttal
descr:
Granted by [Divine Rebuttal](/feat/divine-rebuttal-player-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw (or a +3 circumstance bonus on a critical hit).

name: Effect: Divine Weapon
descr:
Granted by [Divine Weapon](/feat/divine-weapon-player-core)

The weapon deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage. If you are holy or unholy, Strikes with the weapon also gain that trait, and the additional damage increases to 2d4 against creatures of the opposing trait.

name: Effect: Divine Wings
descr:
Granted by [Divine Wings](/feat/divine-wings-player-core)

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Effect: Dueling Parry
descr:
Granted by [Dueling Parry](/feat/dueling-parry-player-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Dwarven Reinforcement
descr:
Granted by [Dwarven Reinforcement](/feat/dwarven-reinforcement-player-core)

An item of your choice gains a bonus to Hardness.

name: Effect: Echoes in Stone
descr:
Granted by [Echoes In Stone](/feat/echoes-in-stone-player-core)

You gain imprecise tremorsense with a range of 20 feet.

name: Effect: Educate Allies
descr:
Granted by [Educate Allies](/feat/educate-allies-player-core).

All allies affected by your composition spell gain your +1 circumstance bonus from [Well Versed](/feat/well-versed-player-core) until the start of your next turn. Your personal circumstance bonus from Well-Versed also increases to +2 until the start of your next turn.

name: Effect: Emblazon Antimagic
descr:
Granted by [Emblazon Antimagic](/feat/emblazon-antimagic-player-core)

**Shield** You gain the shield's circumstance bonus to saving throws against magic.**Weapon** When you critically hit with the weapon, you can attempt to counteract a spell on the target, using half your level, rounded up, as the counteract rank.

name: Effect: Emblazon Armament
descr:
Granted by [Emblazon Armament](/feat/emblazon-armament-player-core)

**Shield** The shield gains a +1 status bonus to its Hardness.
**Weapon** The wielder gains a +1 status bonus to damage rolls with the weapon.

name: Effect: Emblazon Energy
descr:
Granted by [Emblazon Energy](/feat/emblazon-energy-player-core)

**Shield** Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain the shield's circumstance bonus to saving throws against that damage type.**Weapon** Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The weapon deals an extra 1d4 damage of that type. Increase this extra damage to 1d6 if you have a domain spell with a trait matching that type.

name: Effect: Energy Ablation
descr:
Granted by [Energy Ablation](/feat/energy-ablation-player-core)

You gain resistance to an energy damage type of your choice equal to the spell's rank.

name: Effect: Familiar of Balanced Luck
descr:
Granted by [Familiar Of Balanced Luck](/action/familiar-of-balanced-luck-player-core)

You gain either a +1 status bonus to its AC or a –1 status penalty to your AC.

name: Effect: Familiar of Keen Senses
descr:
Granted by [Familiar Of Keen Senses](/action/familiar-of-keen-senses-player-core)

Your familiar gains your choice of an imprecise scent, tremorsense, or wavesense, with a range of 60 feet.

name: Effect: Familiar of Restored Spirit
descr:
Granted by [Familiar Of Restored Spirit](/action/familiar-of-restored-spirit-player-core)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to 2 + half the caster's level.

name: Effect: Follow The Expert
descr:
Granted by [Follow The Expert](/action/follow-the-expert-player-core)

You can add your level as a proficiency bonus to the associated skill check, even if you're untrained. Additionally, you gain a circumstance bonus to your skill check based on your ally's proficiency.

name: Effect: Forcible Energy
descr:
Granted by [Forcible Energy](/feat/forcible-energy-player-core)

The target gains weakness 5 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage.

name: Effect: Guardian's Deflection
descr:
Granted by [Guardian'S Deflection (Fighter)](/feat/guardian-s-deflection-fighter-player-core) or [Guardian'S Deflection (Swashbuckler)](/feat/guardian-s-deflection-swashbuckler-player-core-2).

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Effect: Guidance Immunity
descr: Granted when someone uses [Guidance](/spell/guidance-player-core) on you, rendering you immune to the effect of the spell for the duration.

name: Effect: Hunt Prey
descr:
Granted by [Hunt Prey](/action/hunt-prey-player-core)

You mark a creature as your prey.

name: Effect: Hunter's Aim
descr:
Granted by [Hunter'S Aim](/feat/hunter-s-aim-player-core) via Ephemeral Effect

Your lesser cover is ignored by the origin's ranged attack roll.

name: Effect: Improvised Weapon
descr: You take a –2 item penalty to attack rolls with an improvised weapon.

name: Effect: Inspired Stratagem
descr:
Granted by [Inspired Stratagem](/action/inspired-stratagem-player-core)

You roll the triggering check twice and take the better of the two results.

name: Effect: Kneecap
descr:
Granted by [Kneecap](/feat/kneecap-player-core)

The target takes a status penalty to its Speed.

name: Effect: Legendary Monster Hunter
descr:
Granted by [Monster Hunter](/feat/monster-hunter-player-core) if you have [Legendary Monster Hunter](/feat/legendary-monster-hunter-player-core).

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey.

name: Effect: Legendary Monster Warden
descr:
Granted by [Monster Warden](/feat/monster-warden-player-core) if you have [Legendary Monster Hunter](/feat/legendary-monster-hunter-player-core).

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against that particular creature and to your AC against that creature's next attack against you.

name: Effect: Manacles
descr:
Granted by [Manacles (Poor)](/item/manacles-poor-player-core), [Manacles (Simple)](/item/manacles-simple-player-core), [Manacles (Average)](/item/manacles-average-player-core), [Manacles (Good)](/item/manacles-good-player-core), [Manacles (Superior)](/item/manacles-superior-player-core)

**Legs** You take a –15-foot circumstance penalty to your Speeds

**Wrists** You must succeed at a DC 5 flat check any time you use a manipulate action or else that action fails.

name: Effect: Methodical Debilitations (Cover)
descr:
Granted by [Methodical Debilitations](/feat/methodical-debilitations-player-core)

You cannot gain a circumstance bonus to AC from Raising a Shield, lesser cover, or standard cover.

name: Effect: Monster Hunter
descr:
Granted by [Monster Hunter](/feat/monster-hunter-player-core)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against the assessed creature. This bonus increases to +2 if the origin has Legendary Monster Hunter.

name: Effect: Monster Warden
descr:
Granted by [Monster Warden](/feat/monster-warden-player-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus either to your AC the next time the assessed creature attacks you or to your next saving throw against an effect from that particular creature.

name: Effect: Mountain Strategy (Critically Hit)
descr:
Granted by [Mountain Strategy](/feat/mountain-strategy-player-core)

Marks a target that critically hit you.

name: Effect: Mounted
descr:
See [Mounted Combat](/rule/mounted-combat-rules-2434)

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves while mounted.

name: Effect: Overextending Feint
descr:
Granted by [Overextending Feint](/feat/overextending-feint-player-core)

You take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls against the opponent.

name: Effect: Parry
descr: You gain a circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Precise Debilitations
descr:
Granted by [Precise Debilitations](/feat/precise-debilitations-player-core)

The target takes an additional 2d6 precision damage from your attacks.

name: Effect: Predictable!
descr:
Granted by [Predictable!](/feat/predictable-player-core)

You gain a circumstance bonus to AC and your next saving throw against the target. On a critical failure, you take a –1 circumstance penalty instead.

name: Effect: Predictable! (Saving Throw)
descr:
Granted by [Predictable](/feat/predictable-player-core)

You gain a circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against the target. On a critical failure, you take a –1 circumstance penalty instead.

name: Effect: Premonition of Clarity
descr:
Granted by [Premonition Of Clarity](/feat/premonition-of-clarity-player-core)

Reroll the triggering saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus.

name: Effect: Primal Aegis
descr:
Granted by [Primal Aegis](/feat/primal-aegis-player-core)

You gain resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, vitality, and void damage.

name: Effect: Raise a Shield
descr:
Granted by [Raise A Shield](/action/raise-a-shield-player-core)

When you have Raised a Shield, you gain its listed circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Raise Menhir
descr:
Granted by [Raise Menhir](/feat/raise-menhir-player-core)

Choose arcane, divine, or occult; all creatures within 15 feet of the monument gain a +2 status bonus to their saving throws against effects with that trait.

name: Effect: Raise Symbol
descr:
Granted by [Raise Symbol](/feat/raise-symbol-player-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws until the start of your next turn. While it's raised, if you roll a success at a saving throw against a vitality or void effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Effect: Remaining Air
descr:
See [Drowning and Suffocating](/rule/drowning-and-suffocating-rules-2439)

You can hold your breath for a number of rounds equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier. Reduce your remaining air by 1 round at the end of each of your turns, or by 2 if you attacked or cast any spells that turn.

You also lose 1 round worth of air each time you are critically hit or critically fail a save against a damaging effect. If you speak (including Casting a Spell) you lose all remaining air.

name: Effect: Replenishment of War
descr:
Granted by [Replenishment Of War](/feat/replenishment-of-war-player-core)

You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, or equal to your level if the Strike was a critical hit.

name: Effect: Resounding Bravery
descr:
Granted by [Resounding Bravery](/feat/resounding-bravery-player-core)

You gain a +1 status bonus to saves and a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. These benefits are doubled if you critically succeed against a fear effect.

name: Effect: Resounding Finale
descr:
Granted by [Resounding Finale](/feat/resounding-finale-player-core)

You gain sonic resistance against the triggering damage.

name: Effect: Restorative Strike
descr:
Granted by [Restorative Strike](/feat/restorative-strike-player-core)

Cast a 1-action [Harm](/spell/harm-player-core) or [Heal](/spell/heal-player-core) spell to heal yourself, expending the spell normally. It loses the [manipulate](/trait/manipulate) trait when cast this way. Then make a melee Strike. If you make this Strike with your deity's favored weapon, you gain a +1 status bonus to the attack roll.

If the Strike hits, you can target a second willing creature to heal the same amount from the spell. This creature can be outside of the spell's range, provided it's adjacent to the enemy you hit.

name: Effect: Resurrectionist
descr:
Granted by [Resurrectionist](/feat/resurrectionist-player-core)

You gain fast healing 5.

name: Effect: Sanctify Armament
descr:
Granted by [Sanctify Armament](/feat/sanctify-armament-player-core)

The weapon gains the origin's holy or [unholy](/trait/unholy) trait. It also deals an additional 2d6 spirit damage to creatures of the opposed trait.

name: Effect: Scout
descr:
Granted by [Scout](/action/scout-player-core)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll.

name: Effect: Scout's Warning
descr:
Granted by [Scout'S Warning](/feat/scout-s-warning-player-core)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll (+2 if you also benefit from [Scout](/action/scout-player-core)).

name: Effect: Share Hunter's Edge (Flurry)
descr:
Granted by [Animal Companion (Ranger)](/feat/animal-companion-ranger-player-core), [Shared Prey](/feat/shared-prey-player-core), [Triple Threat](/feat/triple-threat-player-core), [Warden'S Boon](/feat/warden-s-boon-player-core)

Your multiple attack penalty for attacks against the marked creature is –3 (–2 with an agile attack) on your second attack of the turn instead of –5, and –6 (–4 with an agile attack) on your third or subsequent attack of the turn, instead of –10.

name: Effect: Share Hunter's Edge (Flurry, Masterful)
descr:
Granted by [Animal Companion (Ranger)](/feat/animal-companion-ranger-player-core) with [Masterful Companion](/feat/masterful-companion-player-core)

Your multiple attack penalty for attacks against the marked creature is –2 (–1 with an agile attack) on your second attack of the turn instead of –5, and –4 (–2 with an agile attack) on your third or subsequent attack of the turn, instead of –10.

name: Effect: Share Hunter's Edge (Outwit)
descr:
Granted by [Animal Companion (Ranger)](/feat/animal-companion-ranger-player-core), [Shared Prey](/feat/shared-prey-player-core), [Triple Threat](/feat/triple-threat-player-core), [Warden'S Boon](/feat/warden-s-boon-player-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks, Intimidation checks, Stealth checks, and any checks to Recall Knowledge about the marked creature, and a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the marked creature's attacks.

name: Effect: Share Hunter's Edge (Outwit, Masterful)
descr:
Granted by [Animal Companion (Ranger)](/feat/animal-companion-ranger-player-core) with [Masterful Companion](/feat/masterful-companion-player-core)

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks, Intimidation checks, Stealth checks, and any checks to Recall Knowledge about the marked creature, and a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the marked creature's attacks.

name: Effect: Share Hunter's Edge (Precision)
descr:
Granted by [Animal Companion (Ranger)](/feat/animal-companion-ranger-player-core), [Shared Prey](/feat/shared-prey-player-core), [Triple Threat](/feat/triple-threat-player-core), [Warden'S Boon](/feat/warden-s-boon-player-core)

The first time you hit the marked creature in a round, you deal 1d8 additional precision damage. At 11th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8 precision damage, and at 19th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 precision damage.

name: Effect: Share Hunter's Edge (Precision, Masterful)
descr:
Granted by [Animal Companion (Ranger)](/feat/animal-companion-ranger-player-core) with [Masterful Companion](/feat/masterful-companion-player-core)

The first time you hit the marked creature in a round, you deal 2d8 additional precision damage. At 19th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 precision damage.

The second time in a round you hit the marked creature, you also deal 1d8 precision damage. At 19th level this extra damage increases to 2d8 precision damage, and your third hit in a round against the marked creature deals 1d8 precision damage.

name: Effect: Shared Avoidance
descr:
Granted by [Shared Avoidance](/feat/shared-avoidance-player-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against the hazard.

name: Effect: Shared Clarity
descr:
Granted by [Shared Clarity](/feat/shared-clarity-player-core)

You can reroll the failed saving throw against the mental effect with a +2 circumstance bonus.

name: Effect: Shield Immunity
descr:
Granted by [Shield](/spell/shield-player-core)

After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

name: Effect: Shield of Faith
descr:
Granted by [Shield Of Faith](/feat/shield-of-faith-player-core)

You gain a +1 status bonus to your AC.

name: Effect: Spell Protection Array
descr:
Granted by [Spell Protection Array](/feat/spell-protection-array-player-core)

You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against magic.

name: Effect: Spined Shield Spines
descr:
Granted by [Spined Shield](/item/spined-shield-player-core)

When you use the Shield Block reaction with this shield, the spines take the damage before the shield itself does. When the shield would take damage (after applying Hardness), one spine snaps off per 6 damage, reducing the damage by 6.

name: Effect: Sympathetic Strike

You take –1 circumstance penalty to your saves against the origin's hexes, or a –2 penalty if the triggering Strike was a critical hit.

name: Effect: Tactical Debilitations (No Flanking)
descr:
Granted by [Tactical Debilitations](/feat/tactical-debilitations-player-core)

The target can't flank or contribute to allies' flanking.

name: Effect: Treat Disease
descr:
Granted by [Treat Disease](/action/treat-disease-player-core)

You gain a circumstance bonus or penalty to your next save against the disease.

name: Effect: Treat Poison
descr:
Granted by [Treat Poison](/action/treat-poison-player-core)

You gain a circumstance bonus or penalty to your next save against the poison.

name: Effect: Undying Ferocity
descr:
Granted by [Undying Ferocity](/feat/undying-ferocity-player-core)

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level.

name: Effect: Vicious Debilitations
descr:
Granted by [Vicious Debilitations](/feat/vicious-debilitations-player-core)

You gain weakness 5 to your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

name: Effect: Vigorous Anthem
descr:
Granted by [Vigorous Anthem](/feat/vigorous-anthem-player-core)

You gain temporary HP equal to 3 + the source's Charisma modifier.

name: Effect: Watch Your Back
descr:
Granted by [Watch Your Back](/feat/watch-your-back-player-core)

The target gains a +2 status bonus to Perception checks against you, but it takes a –2 status penalty to Will saves against fear effects.

name: Encumbered
descr: You are carrying more weight than you can manage. While you're encumbered, you're Clumsy 1 and take a 10-foot penalty to all your Speeds. As with all penalties to your Speed, this can't reduce your Speed below 5 feet.

name: Enfeebled
descr: You're physically weakened. Enfeebled always includes a value. When you are enfeebled, you take a status penalty equal to the condition value to Strength-based rolls and DCs, including Strength-based melee attack rolls, Strength-based damage rolls, and Athletics checks.

name: Fascinated
descr: You're compelled to focus your attention on something, distracting you from whatever else is going on around you. You take a –2 status penalty to Perception and skill checks, and you can't use concentrate actions unless they (or their intended consequences) are related to the subject of your fascination, as determined by the GM. For instance, you might be able to Seek and Recall Knowledge about the subject, but you likely couldn't cast a spell targeting a different creature. This condition ends if a creature uses hostile actions against you or any of your allies.

name: Fatigued
descr:
You're tired and can't summon much energy. You take a –1 status penalty to AC and saving throws. You can't use exploration activities performed while traveling.

You recover from fatigue after a full night's rest.

name: Fleeing
descr: You're forced to run away due to fear or some other compulsion. On your turn, you must spend each of your actions trying to escape the source of the fleeing condition as expediently as possible (such as by using move actions to flee, or opening doors barring your escape). The source is usually the effect or creature that gave you the condition, though some effects might define something else as the source. You can't Delay or Ready while fleeing.

name: Friendly
descr: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC. A creature that is friendly to a character likes that character. It is likely to agree to Requests from that character as long as they are simple, safe, and don't cost too much to fulfill. If the character (or one of their allies) uses hostile actions against the creature, the creature gains a worse attitude condition depending on the severity of the hostile action, as determined by the GM.

name: Frightened
descr: You're gripped by fear and struggle to control your nerves. The frightened condition always includes a value. You take a status penalty equal to this value to all your checks and DCs. Unless specified otherwise, at the end of each of your turns, the value of your frightened condition decreases by 1.

name: Grabbed
descr: You're held in place by another creature, giving you the Off Guard and Immobilized conditions. If you attempt a manipulate action while grabbed, you must succeed at a Flat DC 5 or it is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.

name: Helpful
descr: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC. A creature that is helpful to a character wishes to actively aid that character. It will accept reasonable Requests from that character, as long as such requests aren't at the expense of the helpful creature's goals or quality of life. If the character (or one of their allies) uses a hostile action against the creature, the creature gains a worse attitude condition depending on the severity of the hostile action, as determined by the GM.

name: Hidden
descr:
While you're hidden from a creature, that creature knows the space you're in but can't tell precisely where you are. You typically become hidden by using Stealth to Hide. When Seeking a creature using only imprecise senses, it remains hidden, rather than Observed. A creature you're hidden from is Off Guard to you, and it must succeed at a Flat DC 11 when targeting you with an attack, spell, or other effect or it fails to affect you. Area effects aren't subject to this flat check.

A creature might be able to use the seek action to try to observe you.

name: Hostile
descr: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose on a PC. A creature hostile to a character actively seeks to harm that character. It doesn't necessarily attack, but it won't accept Requests from the character.

name: Immobilized
descr: You are incapable of movement. You can't use any actions that have the move trait. If you're immobilized by something holding you in place and an external force would move you out of your space, the force must succeed at a check against either the DC of the effect holding you in place or the relevant defense (usually Fortitude DC) of the monster holding you in place.

name: Indifferent
descr: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC. A creature that is indifferent to a character doesn't really care one way or the other about that character. Assume a creature's attitude to a given character is indifferent unless specified otherwise.

name: Invisible
descr: You can't be seen. You're Undetected to everyone. Creatures can Seek to detect you; if a creature succeeds at its Perception check against your Stealth DC, you become Hidden to that creature until you Sneak to become undetected again. If you become invisible while someone can already see you, you start out hidden to them (instead of undetected) until you successfully Sneak. You can't become Observed while invisible except via special abilities or magic.

name: Observed
descr: Anything in plain view is observed by you. If a creature takes measures to avoid detection, such as by using Stealth to Hide, it can become Hidden or Undetected instead of observed. If you have another precise sense besides sight, you might be able to observe a creature or object using that sense instead. You can observe a creature with only your precise senses. When Seeking a creature using only imprecise senses, it remains hidden, rather than observed.

name: Off-Guard
descr: You're distracted or otherwise unable to focus your full attention on defense. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to AC. Some effects give you the off-guard condition only to certain creatures or against certain attacks. Others—especially conditions—can make you off-guard against everything. If a rule doesn't specify that the condition applies only to certain circumstances, it applies to all of them, such as "The target is off-guard."

name: Paralyzed
descr: You're frozen in place. You have the Off Guard condition and can't act except to Recall Knowledge and use actions that require only your mind (as determined by the GM). Your senses still function, but only in the areas you can perceive without moving, so you can't Seek.

name: Persistent Damage
descr: You are taking damage from an ongoing effect, such as from being lit on fire. This appears as "X persistent [type] damage," where "X" is the amount of damage dealt and "[type]" is the damage type. Like normal damage, it can be doubled or halved based on the results of an attack roll or saving throw. Instead of taking persistent damage immediately, you take it at the end of each of your turns as long as you have the condition, rolling any damage dice anew each time. After you take persistent damage, roll a Flat DC 15 to see if you recover from the persistent damage. If you succeed, the condition ends.

name: Petrified
descr: You have been turned to stone. You can't act, nor can you sense anything. You become an object with a Bulk double your normal Bulk (typically 12 for a petrified Medium creature or 6 for a petrified Small creature), AC 9, Hardness 8, and the same current Hit Points you had when alive. You don't have a Broken Threshold. When the petrified condition ends, you have the same number of Hit Points you had as a statue. If the statue is destroyed, you immediately die. While petrified, your mind and body are in stasis, so you don't age or notice the passing of time.

name: Prone
descr:
You're lying on the ground. You are Off Guard and take a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. The only move actions you can use while you're prone are Crawl and Stand. Standing up ends the prone condition. You can Take Cover while prone to hunker down and gain greater cover against ranged attacks, even if you don't have an object to get behind, which grants you a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks (but you remain off-guard).

If you would be knocked prone while you're Climbing or Flying, you fall. You can't be knocked prone when Swimming.

name: Quickened
descr: You're able to act more quickly. You gain 1 additional action at the start of your turn each round. Many effects that make you quickened require you use this extra action only in certain ways. If you become quickened from multiple sources, you can use the extra action you've been granted for any single action allowed by any of the effects that made you quickened. Because quickened has its effect at the start of your turn, you don't immediately gain actions if you become quickened during your turn.

name: Restrained
descr: You're tied up and can barely move, or a creature has you pinned. You have the Off Guard and Immobilized conditions, and you can't use any attack or manipulate actions except to attempt to Escape or Force Open your bonds. Restrained overrides Grabbed.

name: Sickened
descr: Rules

name: Slowed
descr: You have fewer actions. Slowed always includes a value. When you regain your actions, reduce the number of actions regained by your slowed value. Because you regain actions at the start of your turn, you don't immediately lose actions if you become slowed during your turn.

descr:
Granted by [Acid Grip](/spell/acid-grip-player-core)

AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

5 temporary Hit Points.

Low-light vision.

name: Spell Effect: Dragon Form
descr:
Granted by [Dragon Form](/spell/dragon-form-player-core)

You gain a Large dragon battle form. Choose one type of dragon. While in this form, you gain the [dragon](/trait/dragon) trait. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

10 temporary Hit Points.

Speed 40 feet, fly 100 feet. You gain any of the following Speeds the chosen dragon has, but with the listed amount: burrow 20 feet, climb 40 feet, swim 60 feet.

Resistance 10 against the damage type of your Dragon Breath.

Darkvision and imprecise scent 60 feet.

The following unarmed melee attacks, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +22, and your damage bonus is +6. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead. See below for more on these attacks.

**Melee** 1 jaws, **Damage** 2d12 piercing plus 2d6 damage of the same damage type as your Dragon Breath;

**Melee** 1 claw (agile), **Damage** 3d10 slashing;

**Melee** 1 tail (reach 10 feet), **Damage** 3d10 bludgeoning.

Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own is higher.

**Dragon Breath** 2 You exhale deadly magical energy in an area, dealing 10d6 damage to each creature in the area with a basic save against your spell DC. The shape, damage type, and save type match that of your chosen dragon's breath. If the chosen dragon's breath can deal more than one type of damage, choose one when you cast dragon form. The shape is a 30-foot cone or a 100-foot line. Once activated, Dragon Breath can't be used again for 1d4 rounds. Dragon Breath has the tradition trait matching the type of dragon and the damage trait matching the type of damage it deals, if applicable.

**Tradition Resistance** If the dragon's magical tradition matches that of your dragon form spell, you gain the listed ability. **Arcane** resistance 5 against magic; **divine** resistance 10 to spirit, vitality, and void; **occult** resistance 10 to mental; **primal** resistance 5 to physical damage.

---

**Heightened (8th)** Your battle form is Huge, you gain a +20-foot status bonus to your fly Speed, and your attacks have 10-foot reach (or 15-foot reach if they previously had 10-foot reach). You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary HP, an attack modifier of +28, a damage bonus of +12, and Athletics +28. Your Dragon Breath deals an additional 4d6 damage.

name: Spell Effect: Magic's Vessel (Resistance)
descr:
Granted by [Magic'S Vessel](/spell/magic-s-vessel-player-core)

You gain resistance to damage from spells equal to the spell's rank.

name: Spell Effect: Malignant Sustenance
descr:
Granted by [Malignant Sustenance](/spell/malignant-sustenance-player-core)

You gain fast healing 7

---

**Heightened (+1)** The fast healing increases by 2.

name: Spell Effect: Monstrosity Form
descr:
Granted by [Monstrosity Form](/spell/monstrosity-form-player-core)

You transform into the shape of a legendary monster, assuming a Huge battle form. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the [beast](/trait/beast) trait (for phoenix) or the [animal](/trait/animal) trait (for cave worm or sea serpent). You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.20 temporary Hit Points.Darkvision.One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +28, and you use the listed damage. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [Enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +30, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of monster you choose:

**Cave Worm**

Speed 40 feet, burrow 30 feet, swim 20 feet;**Melee** 1 jaws (reach 10 feet), **Damage** 2d12+20 piercing;**Melee** 1 stinger (agile, reach 10 feet), **Damage** 2d8+15 piercing plus 2d6 persistent poison;**Melee** 1 body (reach 10 feet) **Damage** 2d8+20 bludgeoning;**Inexorable** You automatically recover from the [Paralyzed](/condition/paralyzed-player-core), [Slowed](/condition/slowed-player-core), and [Stunned](/condition/stunned-player-core) conditions at the end of each of your turns. You're also immune to being [Immobilized](/condition/immobilized-player-core) and ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

**Phoenix**

Speed 30 feet, fly 90 feet;**Melee** 1 beak (reach 15 feet), **Damage** 2d6+12 piercing plus 2d4 fire and 2d4 persistent fire;**Melee** 1 talon (agile, reach 15 feet), **Damage** 2d8+12 slashing;**Shroud of Flame** (aura, fire, primal) 20 feet. You gain an aura of fire that extends out from you. A creature that enters or ends its turn within the aura takes 2d6 fire damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. You can activate or deactivate this aura with a [Sustain](/action/sustain-player-core) action.

**Sea Serpent**

Speed 20 feet, swim 90 feet;**Melee** 1 jaws (reach 15 feet), **Damage** 2d12+20 piercing;**Melee** 1 tail (reach 25 feet), **Damage** 2d8+20 bludgeoning;**Spine Rake** 2 (move) You extend your spines and Swim or Stride. Each creature you're adjacent to at any point during your movement takes 4d8+10 slashing damage (basic Reflex against your spell DC).

---

**Heightened (9th)** You instead gain AC = 22 + your level, 25 temporary HP, attack modifier +31, increase damage by one damage die, and Athletics +33.

name: Spell Effect: Moon Frenzy
descr:
Granted by [Moon Frenzy](/spell/moon-frenzy-player-core)

You gain temporary Hit Points, a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds, and weakness to silver. You also grow vicious fangs and claws, which are unarmed attacks. If a target is in the light of a full moon, it also grows by one size if it were Medium or smaller. This increases the reach of a Medium or Tiny creature by 5 feet.

name: Spell Effect: Mountain Resilience
descr:
Granted by [Mountain Resilience](/spell/mountain-resilience-player-core)

You gain resistance to physical damage, except adamantine.

name: Spell Effect: Mystic Armor
descr:
Granted by [Mystic Armor](/spell/mystic-armor-player-core)

You gain an item bonus to AC and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5. At 4th rank or higher, you gain an item bonus to saving throws.

name: Spell Effect: Nature Incarnate
descr:
Granted by [Nature Incarnate](/spell/nature-incarnate-player-core)

You transform into an incarnation of nature, either a green man or a kaiju. Your battle form is Medium for a green man or Gargantuan (30-foot-by-30-foot space) for a kaiju. While in this form, you gain the [plant](/trait/plant) trait (for a green man) or the [beast](/trait/beast) trait (for a kaiju). You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

AC = 25 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.30 temporary Hit Points.Darkvision.One or more attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +34, and you use the listed damage. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [Enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +36, unless your own is higher.

You gain specific abilities based on the incarnation you choose:

**Green Man**

Speed 40 feet, climb 40 feet;**Melee** 1 vines (reach 30 feet, versatile P), **Damage** 6d8+12 bludgeoning;**Ranged** 1 thorns (range 100 feet), **Damage** 6d6+6 piercing;**Green Caress** (aura, primal) 60 feet. Enemies other than plants must succeed at a Fortitude against your spell DC or become [Clumsy 1](/condition/clumsy-player-core) for 1 round (Clumsy 2 on a critical failure).

**Kaiju**

Speed 50 feet; resistance 5 to physical damage;**Melee** 1 jaws (reach 30 feet), **Damage** 6d10+10 piercing;**Melee** 1 claws (agile, reach 30 feet), **Damage** 6d8+8 slashing;**Melee** 1 foot (agile, reach 15 feet), **Damage** 6d6+10 bludgeoning;**Unstoppable** You are immune to being [Immobilized](/condition/immobilized-player-core) and ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain;**Trample** 3 You move up to double your Speed and move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures, trampling each creature whose space you enter. A trampled creature takes foot damage with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.

name: Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience
descr:
Granted by [Oaken Resilience](/spell/oaken-resilience-player-core)

You gain resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage and weakness to fire.

name: Spell Effect: Outcast's Curse (Failure)
descr:
Granted by [Outcast'S Curse](/spell/outcast-s-curse-player-core)

You must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check.

name: Spell Effect: Outcast's Curse (Success)
descr:
Granted by [Outcast'S Curse](/spell/outcast-s-curse-player-core)

You must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check.

name: Spell Effect: Overstuff
descr:
Granted by [Overstuff](/spell/overstuff-player-core)

You are sickened and take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speed until you are no longer sickened.

name: Spell Effect: Pest Form
descr:
Granted by [Pest Form](/spell/pest-form-player-core)

You transform into the battle form of a Tiny animal. While in this form, you gain the [animal](/trait/animal) trait and you can't make Strikes. You gain the following statistics and abilities:

AC = 15 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.Speed 20 feet.Weakness 5 to physical damage. (If you take physical damage in this form, you take 5 additional damage.)Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.Acrobatics and Stealth modifiers of +10, unless your own modifier is higher; Athletics modifier -4.

---

**Heightened (4th)** You can turn into a flying creature, such as a bird, which grants you a fly Speed of 20 feet.

name: Spell Effect: Phase Familiar
descr:
Granted by [Phase Familiar](/spell/phase-familiar-player-core)

Your familiar gains resistance to all damage and is immune to precision damage.

name: Spell Effect: Plant Form
descr:
Granted by [Plant Form](/spell/plant-form-player-core)

You transform into a Large plant battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose a listed battle form. You can substitute a similar specific plant to turn into (such as a pitcher plant instead of a flytrap), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the [plant](/trait/plant) trait. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

AC = 19 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.

12 temporary Hit Points.

Resistance 10 to poison.

Low-light vision.

One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +17, and your damage bonus is +11. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the [Enfeebled](/condition/enfeebled-player-core) condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.

Athletics modifier of +19, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of plant you choose:

**Arboreal**

Speed 30 feet;

**Melee** 1 branch (reach 15 feet), **Damage** 2d10 bludgeoning;

**Melee** 1 foot, **Damage** 2d8 bludgeoning;

You can speak in this form.

**Flytrap**

Speed 15 feet;

Resistance 10 to acid;

**Melee** 1 leaf (reach 10 feet), **Damage** 2d8 piercing, and you can spend an action after a hit to Grab the target.

---

**Heightened (6th)** Your battle form is Huge, and the reach of your attacks increases by 5 feet. You instead gain AC = 22 + your level, 24 temporary HP, attack modifier +21, damage bonus +16, and Athletics +22.

name: Spell Effect: Precious Metals
descr:
Granted by [Precious Metals](/spell/precious-metals-player-core)

The metal in the target transforms from its normal metal into cold iron, copper, gold, iron, silver, or steel. If the spell's rank is 8th or higher, add adamantine and dawnsilver to the options.

name: Spell Effect: Primal Summons
descr:
Granted by [Primal Summons](/spell/primal-summons-player-core)

Choose air, earth, fire, metal, water or wood; the creature you summon gains the corresponding abilities.

**Air** The creature gains a fly Speed of 60 feet.**Earth** The creature gains a burrow Speed of 20 feet, reduces its land Speed by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet), and gains resistance 5 to physical damage.**Fire** The creature's Strikes deal 1d6 extra fire damage, and it gains resistance 10 to fire and weakness 5 to cold and water.**Metal** The creature's Strikes deal 1d6 extra electricity damage, and it gains resistance 5 to electricity.**Water** The creature gains a swim Speed of 60 feet, can spend 1 action after a melee attack to attempt a Shove (ignoring multiple attack penalty), and gains resistance 5 to fire.**Wood** The creature gains a climb speed of 30 feet and resistance 2 to bludgeoning and piercing damage.

name: Spell Effect: Protection
descr:
Granted by [Protection](/spell/protection-player-core).

You gain a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.

name: Spell Effect: Protective Wards
descr:
Granted by [Protective Wards](/spell/protective-wards-player-core)

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC.

name: Spell Effect: Protector's Sphere
descr:
Granted by [Protector'S Sphere](/spell/protector-s-sphere-player-core)

You gain resistance to all damage.

name: Spell Effect: Rallying Anthem
descr:
Granted by [Rallying Anthem](/spell/rallying-anthem-player-core)

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws, as well as resistance equal to half the spell's rank to physical damage.

name: Spell Effect: Read Aura
descr:
Granted by [Read Aura](/spell/read-aura-player-core)

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Identify Magic.

name: Spell Effect: Regenerate
descr:
Granted by [Regenerate](/spell/regenerate-player-core)

The target gains regeneration, which restores Hit Points to it at the start of each of its turns.

name: Spell Effect: Resist Energy
descr:
Granted by [Resist Energy](/spell/resist-energy-player-core)

Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. You gain resistance against the damage type you chose.

name: Spell Effect: Runic Body
descr:
Granted by [Runic Body](/spell/runic-body-player-core)

Your unarmed attacks become *+1 striking* unarmed attacks, gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of damage dice to two.

---

**Heightened (6th)** The unarmed attacks are *+2 greater striking*.

**Heightened (9th)** The unarmed attacks are *+3 major striking*.

name: Spell Effect: Runic Weapon
descr:
Granted by [Runic Weapon](/spell/runic-weapon-player-core)

The target weapon becomes a *+1 [striking](/item/striking-gm-core) weapon*, gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice to two.

---

**Heightened (6th)** The weapon is *+2 greater striking*.

**Heightened (9th)** The weapon is *+3 major striking*.

name: Spell Effect: Safe Passage
descr:
Granted by [Safe Passage](/spell/safe-passage-player-core)

You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and saves against harmful effects of the terrain and environment, and resistance to all damage from such effects.

name: Spell Effect: Safeguard Secret
descr:
Granted by [Safeguard Secret](/spell/safeguard-secret-player-core).

The targets gain +4 status bonus to skill checks (typically Deception checks) to conceal this knowledge and to saving throws against spells that specifically attempt to obtain this knowledge from them and effects that would force them to reveal it.

name: Spell Effect: Savor the Sting
descr:
Granted by [Savor The Sting](/spell/savor-the-sting-player-core)

As long as your target is taking persistent damage from this spell, you gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks against the target.

name: Spell Effect: Scholarly Recollection
descr:
Granted by [Scholarly Recollection](/spell/scholarly-recollection-player-core)

For your Perception check to Seek, or your skill check to Recall Knowledge with a skill you're trained in, you roll the triggering check twice and use the better result.

name: Spell Effect: See the Unseen
descr:
Granted by [See The Unseen](/spell/see-the-unseen-player-core)

You can see [invisible](/condition/invisible-player-core) creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them [Concealed](/condition/concealed-player-core) and difficult to identify. You also gain a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

name: Spell Effect: Shield
descr:
Granted by [Shield](/spell/shield-player-core)

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. While the spell is in effect, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your magic shield. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends.

name: Spell Effect: Shifting Form
descr:
Granted by [Shifting Form](/spell/shifting-form-player-core)

You gain one of the following abilities of your choice.

You gain a 20-foot status bonus to your Speed.
You gain a climb or swim Speed equal to half your Speed.
You gain darkvision.
You gain a pair of claws. These are agile finesse unarmed attacks that deal 1d8 slashing damage.
You gain scent 60 feet (imprecise).

name: Spell Effect: Shrink
descr:
Granted by [Shrink](/spell/shrink-player-core)

You shrink to become Tiny in size. Your equipment shrinks with you but returns to its original size if removed. Your reach changes to 0 feet.

name: Spell Effect: Silence
descr:
Granted by [Silence](/spell/silence-player-core)

You make no sound, preventing creatures from noticing you using hearing alone.

---

**Heightened (4th)** The spell creates an aura in a 10-foot emanation around you, silencing all sound in or passing through it. While within the aura, creatures are subject to the same effects as the target.

name: Spell Effect: Song of Strength
descr:
Granted by [Song Of Strength](/spell/song-of-strength-player-core)

You gain a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks and DCs against Athletics skill actions such as Disarm, Reposition, Shove, and Trip.

name: Spell Effect: Soothe
descr:
Granted by [Soothe](/spell/soothe-player-core)

You gain a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects.

name: Spell Effect: Soothing Words
descr:
Granted by [Soothing Words](/spell/soothing-words-player-core)

You gain a status bonus to Will saving throws. This bonus increases against emotion effects.

name: Spell Effect: Spiral of Horrors
descr:
Granted by [Spiral Of Horrors](/spell/spiral-of-horrors-player-core)

You are frightened 1 and unable to reduce the condition.

name: Spell Effect: Stoke the Heart
descr:
Granted by [Stoke The Heart](/spell/stoke-the-heart-player-core)

You gain a status bonus to damage rolls.

name: Spell Effect: Stormwind Flight
descr:
Granted by [Stormwind Flight](/spell/stormwind-flight-player-core).

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Sure Strike
descr:
Granted by [Sure Strike](/spell/sure-strike-player-core)

The next time you make an attack roll, roll twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being Concealed or Hidden.

name: Spell Effect: Sweet Dream
descr:
Granted by [Sweet Dream](/spell/sweet-dream-player-core)

**Dream of Insight** status bonus to Intelligence-based skill checks
**Dream of Glamor** status bonus to Charisma-based skill checks
**Dream of Voyaging** +5-foot status bonus to Speed

name: Spell Effect: Tailwind
descr:
Granted by [Tailwind](/spell/tailwind-player-core)

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Tailwind (8 hours)
descr:
Granted by [Tailwind](/spell/tailwind-player-core)

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Take its Course (Affliction, Help)
descr:
Granted by [Take Its Course](/spell/take-its-course-player-core), when used to help a target against an affliction.

The target gains a +2 status bonus to its saving throw against the affliction.

name: Spell Effect: Take its Course (Affliction, Hinder)
descr:
Granted by [Take Its Course](/spell/take-its-course-player-core), when used to hinder a target against an affliction.

The target gains a -2 status bonus to its saving throw against the affliction.

name: Spell Effect: Tangle Vine
descr:
Granted by [Tangle Vine](/spell/tangle-vine-player-core)

You take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to your Speeds. On a critical success, you are also immobilized.

name: Spell Effect: Tangling Creepers
descr:
Granted by [Tangling Creepers](/spell/tangling-creepers-player-core)

You take a -10 circumstance penalty to your land, climb or swim speeds while in the area.

name: Spell Effect: Tempt Fate
descr:
Granted by [Tempt Fate](/spell/tempt-fate-player-core)

You gain a status bonus to the triggering saving throw. If the saving throw's result is a success, it becomes a critical success. If it's a failure, it becomes a critical failure, and the critical failure can't be reduced by abilities that usually reduce critical failure.

name: Spell Effect: Touch of the Moon
descr:
Granted by [Touch Of The Moon](/spell/touch-of-the-moon-player-core)

You glow with dim light in a 20-foot radius. You also get a benefit based on a phase of the moon, starting with the new moon and changing to the next phase at the end of each of your turns.

**New Moon** You receive no benefit.**Waxing Moon** You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +4 status bonus to damage rolls.**Full Moon** You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, AC, and saves, and a +4 status bonus to damage.**Waning Moon** You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws. After this phase, return to the new moon.

name: Spell Effect: Traveler's Transit
descr:
Granted by [Traveler'S Transit](/spell/traveler-s-transit-player-core)

You gain either a climb Speed or a swim Speed. The Speed is equal to your land Speed.

---

**Heightened (5th)** You can choose to gain a fly Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Triple Time
descr:
Granted by [Triple Time](/spell/triple-time-player-core)

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds.

name: Spell Effect: True Target
descr:
Granted by [True Target](/spell/true-target-player-core)

For your next attack roll against the marked creature, roll twice and use the better result. You ignore circumstance penalties to the attack roll.

name: Spell Effect: Unfettered Movement
descr:
Granted by [Unfettered Movement](/spell/unfettered-movement-player-core)

You ignore circumstance penalties to your Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Unimpeded Stride
descr:
Granted by [Unimpeded Stride](/spell/unimpeded-stride-player-core)

You ignore difficult terrain and any circumstance or status penalties to your Speed.

name: Spell Effect: Untamed Form
descr:
Granted by [Untamed Form](/spell/untamed-form-player-core)

You can polymorph into any form listed in *pest form*, which lasts 10 minutes. All other *untamed form* shapes last 1 minute. You can add more shapes to your *untamed form* list with druid feats; your feat might grant you some or all of the shapes from a given polymorph spell.

When you transform into a shape granted by a spell, you gain all the effects of the shape you chose from a version of the spell heightened to *untamed form*'s rank. *Untamed form* allows you to use your own shapeshifting training more easily than most polymorph spells. When you choose to use your own attack modifier while polymorphed instead of the form's default attack modifier, you gain a +2 status bonus to your attack rolls.

---

**Heightened (2nd)** You can transform into shapes listed in *animal form*.

name: Spell Effect: Untamed Shift
descr:
Granted by [Untamed Shift](/spell/untamed-shift-player-core)

You transform just a part of your body.

name: Spell Effect: Uplifting Overture
descr:
Granted by [Uplifting Overture](/spell/uplifting-overture-player-core)

When you later use the Aid reaction, you can roll Performance instead of the normal skill check, and if you roll a failure, you get a success instead. If you are legendary in Performance, you automatically critically succeed.

name: Spell Effect: Vapor Form
descr:
Granted by [Vapor Form](/spell/vapor-form-player-core)

You lose any item bonus to your AC, gain resistance 8 to physical damage, immunity to precision damage, and a fly Speed of 10 feet.

name: Spell Effect: Veil of Dreams
descr:
Granted by [Veil Of Dreams](/spell/veil-of-dreams-player-core)

You take a -1 status penalty to Perception, attack rolls, and Will saves. This penalty increases to -2 for Will saves against sleep effects.

name: Spell Effect: Vital Beacon
descr:
Granted by Vital Beacon

Either you or an ally can use an [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) action to supplicate and lay hands upon you to regain (item level)d((2+2*effect value)) healing vitality Hit Points. This healing decreases each time the beacon heals someone.

name: Spell Effect: Vital Luminance
descr:
Granted by Vital Luminance

You glow with bright light in a 30-foot emanation (and dim light to the next 30 feet).

If an undead creature damages you with an attack or spell while it's within the area of your light, that creature takes vitality damage equal to half your luminance reservoir value. It takes this damage only the first time it damages you in a round. (Healing)

---

*Note: The reservoir value is the effect level times the badge value of this effect. The effect level will be set automatically when casting the spell.*

name: Spell Effect: Volcanic Eruption
descr:
Granted by [Volcanic Eruption](/spell/volcanic-eruption-player-core)

You are clumsy 1 and take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Spell Effect: Weapon Surge
descr:
Granted by [Weapon Surge](/spell/weapon-surge-player-core)

On your next Strike with the weapon before the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 status bonus to the attack roll, the weapon deals additional spirit damage, and the Strike gains the [sanctified](/trait/sanctified) trait.

name: Spell Effect: Word of Truth
descr:
Granted by [Word Of Truth](/spell/word-of-truth-player-core)

You gain a +2 status bonus to Diplomacy checks.

name: Spell Effect: Wrathful Storm
descr:
Granted by [Wrathful Storm](/spell/wrathful-storm-player-core)

You take a -4 circumstance penalty to physical ranged attacks.

name: Spell Effect: Zealous Conviction
descr:
Granted by [Zealous Conviction](/spell/zealous-conviction-player-core)

You gain temporary Hit Points and a status bonus to Will saves against mental effects.

name: Stance: Disarming Stance
descr:
Granted by [Disarming Stance](/feat/disarming-stance-player-core).

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Disarm and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when defending against checks to Disarm you.

name: Stance: Disruptive Stance
descr:
Granted by [Disruptive Stance](/feat/disruptive-stance-player-core)

You can use Reactive Strike when a creature within your reach uses a concentrate action, in addition to manipulate and move actions.

Furthermore, you disrupt a triggering concentrate or manipulate action if your Strike hits (not only if it's a critical hit).

name: Stance: Dueling Dance
descr:
Granted by Dueling Dance (Swashbuckler) or [Dueling Dance (Fighter)](/feat/dueling-dance-fighter-player-core)

You constantly have the benefits of Dueling Parry or Extravagant Parry.

name: Stance: Lunging Stance
descr:
Granted by [Lunging Stance](/feat/lunging-stance-player-core)

You can use Reactive Strike against a creature that is outside your reach but within the reach you would have with a Lunge. If you do, you increase your range with the Strike by 5 feet.

name: Stance: Mobile Shot Stance
descr:
Granted by [Mobile Shot Stance](/feat/mobile-shot-stance-player-core)

Your ranged Strikes don't trigger Attacks of Opportunity or other reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack.

If you have [Reactive Strike](/action/reactive-strike-player-core), you can use it with a loaded ranged weapon you're wielding. The triggering creature must be within 5 feet of you for you to do so.

name: Stance: Multishot Stance
descr:
Granted by [Multishot Stance](/feat/multishot-stance-player-core).

While you are in this stance, your penalty for Double Shot is reduced to -1, or -2 if you add the extra action to make three Strikes. If you move from your position, this stance ends.

name: Stance: Point Blank Stance
descr:
Granted by [Point Blank Stance](/feat/point-blank-stance-player-core)

When using a ranged weapon that doesn't have the [volley](/trait/volley) trait, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls on attacks against targets within the weapon's first range increment.

name: Stance: Ricochet Stance
descr:
Granted by [Ricochet Stance (Fighter)](/feat/ricochet-stance-fighter-player-core) or [Ricochet Stance (Rogue)](/feat/ricochet-stance-rogue-player-core)

While you are in this stance, any thrown weapons you use as part of a ranged Strike to deal bludgeoning or slashing damage immediately return to your hand, enabling you to use them for additional Strikes.

You must be within the weapon's listed range increment and have a hand free to catch the weapon. If you make a ranged Strike with a thrown weapon outside of its listed range increment, it instead flies back toward you a number of feet equal to its listed range increment and then falls to the ground.

name: Stance: Twinned Defense
descr:
Granted by [Twinned Defense (Fighter)](/feat/twinned-defense-fighter-player-core) or Twinned Defense (Swashbuckler)

You constantly gain the benefits of the [Twin Parry](/feat/twin-parry-player-core) action.

name: Stunned
descr:
You've become senseless. You can't act. Stunned usually includes a value, which indicates how many total actions you lose, possibly over multiple turns, from being stunned. Each time you regain actions, reduce the number you regain by your stunned value, then reduce your stunned value by the number of actions you lost. For example, if you were stunned 4, you would lose all 3 of your actions on your turn, reducing you to stunned 1; on your next turn, you would lose 1 more action, and then be able to use your remaining 2 actions normally. Stunned might also have a duration instead, such as "stunned for 1 minute," causing you to lose all your actions for the duration.

Stunned overrides Slowed. If the duration of your stunned condition ends while you are slowed, you count the actions lost to the stunned condition toward those lost to being slowed. So, if you were stunned 1 and slowed 2 at the beginning of your turn, you would lose 1 action from stunned, and then lose only 1 additional action by being slowed, so you would still have 1 action remaining to use that turn.

name: Stupefied
descr: Your thoughts and instincts are clouded. Stupefied always includes a value. You take a status penalty equal to this value on Intelligence-, Wisdom-, and Charisma-based rolls and DCs, including Will saving throws, spell attack modifiers, spell DCs, and skill checks that use these attribute modifiers. Any time you attempt to Cast A Spell while stupefied, the spell is disrupted unless you succeed at a Flat DC 5+condition value with a DC equal to 5 + your stupefied value.

name: Unconscious
descr:
You're sleeping or have been knocked out. You can't act. You take a –4 status penalty to AC, Perception, and Reflex saves, and you have the Blinded and Off Guard conditions. When you gain this condition, you fall Prone and drop items you're holding unless the effect states otherwise or the GM determines you're positioned so you wouldn't.

If you're unconscious because you're Dying, you can't wake up while you have 0 Hit Points. If you are restored to 1 Hit Point or more, you lose the dying and unconscious conditions and can act normally on your next turn.

If you are unconscious and at 0 Hit Points, but not dying, you return to 1 Hit Point and awaken after sufficient time passes. The GM determines how long you remain unconscious, from a minimum of 10 minutes to several hours. If you are healed, you lose the unconscious condition and can act normally on your next turn.

If you're unconscious and have more than 1 Hit Point (typically because you are asleep or unconscious due to an effect), you wake up in one of the following ways.

You take damage, though if the damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points, you remain unconscious and gain the dying condition as normal.
You receive healing, other than the natural healing you get from resting.
Someone shakes you awake with an Interact action.
Loud noise around you might wake you. At the start of your turn, you automatically attempt a Perception check against the noise's DC (or the lowest DC if there is more than one noise), waking up if you succeed. If creatures are attempting to stay quiet around you, this Perception check uses their Stealth DCs. Some effects make you sleep so deeply that they don't allow you this Perception check.
If you are simply asleep, the GM decides you wake up either because you have had a restful night's sleep or something disrupted that rest.

name: Undetected
descr:
When you are undetected by a creature, that creature can't see you at all, has no idea what space you occupy, and can't target you, though you still can be affected by abilities that target an area. When you're undetected by a creature, that creature is Off Guard to you.

A creature you're undetected by can guess which square you're in to try targeting you. It must pick a square and attempt an attack. This works like targeting a Hidden creature (requiring a Flat DC 11), but the flat check and attack roll are rolled in secret by the GM, who doesn't reveal whether the attack missed due to failing the flat check, failing the attack roll, or choosing the wrong square. They can Seek to try to find you.

name: Unfriendly
descr: This condition reflects a creature's disposition toward a particular character, and only supernatural effects (like a spell) can impose this condition on a PC. A creature that is unfriendly to a character dislikes and distrusts that character. The unfriendly creature won't accept Requests from the character.

name: Unnoticed
descr: If you're unnoticed by a creature, that creature has no idea you're present. When you're unnoticed, you're also Undetected. This matters for abilities that can be used only against targets totally unaware of your presence.

name: Wounded
descr:
You have been seriously injured. If you lose the Dying condition and do not already have the wounded condition, you become wounded 1. If you already have the wounded condition when you lose the dying condition, your wounded condition value increases by 1. If you gain the dying condition while wounded, increase your dying condition value by your wounded value.

The wounded condition ends if someone successfully restores Hit Points to you using Treat Wounds, or if you are restored to full Hit Points by any means and rest for 10 minutes.
